notes.title: PARALYSIS MAJOR UPDATE - NEW GAMEMODE
notes.content:
An update to Paralysis has been released. The update will be applied automatically when you restart your Steam client. These changes include:

[h1] [b] NEW FEATURES[/b] [/h1]
[b] EXTRACTION (New Game Mode)[/b]

[list]
[*] At the start of the match you will be given preperation time lasting one minute, during this time you cannot take damage. After this the extraction timer starts and one player, selected randomly, plays as an Alpha creature. The problem is, is that you don't know who this player is, so you can only trust yourself unless your fellow Survivors have proven themselves to not be infected.

[*][b]SURVIVOR[/b]
[list]
[*] As a Survivor you have two ways of surviving... Number one: Survive until the extraction; Number two: Try to figure out who has been infected and kill them. Once all the Alpha creatures are dead the game will end and the Survivors will win.
[/list]
[*][b]ALPHA CREATURE[/b]
[list]
[*] As the Alpha creature, your job is to try and infect all of the Survivors, turning them into Alpha creatures. However if you die as the Alpha creature, you become a part of the Swarm... 
[/list]
[*][b]SWARM[/b]
[list]
[*] Your job as the Swarm is to simply attack and infect other Survivors. However you do not have the ability to transform into a Survivor unlike the Alpha.
[/list]
[/list]
[b]LOBBY[/b]
[list]
[*]New lobby map
[*]Added voice chat to lobby
[/list]
[b]INVENTORY[/b]
[list]
[*]Added drop amount to items in the inventory
[/list]
[b]SOUNDS[/b]
[list]
[*]Added large bunker door sounds
[*]Added small bunker door sounds
[*]Added Item pickup sounds
[*]Added light sounds
[*]Added gas pipe sounds
[*]Added vent sounds
[/list]
[b]MISC[/b]
[list]
[*]Added option to open and close doors
[*]Added gametype to server browser
[/list]
[h1] [b]BUG FIXES[/b] [/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug with creature attack
[*] Fixed customization bug
[*] Fixed ragdoll physics on dead players
[*] Fixed inventory item duplicating
[*] Fixed audio settings not being saved
[/list]
[h1] [b]NEWS AND PLANNED FEATURES[/b] [/h1]
Currently for the next week or two I will be focusing on finding bugs, working on optimization issuses and other small issuses with Paralysis. For the rest of july I will be updating my engine which I need a decent amount time to do, as I need to make sure nothing has broken. I will still be working on new features such as the UI overhaul, a new map, and a few other small things during this time. I will try and get a major update every month such as getting new gun animations, new creature animations, among other things. Also I will need to focus on reworking voice chat to support proximity chat and also adding voice options to the settings menu. Please stay tuned for future updates.

notes.title: PARALYSIS MAJOR UPDATE
notes.content:
Upate to Paralysis has been released. The update will be applied automatically when you restart your Steam client. These changes include:

[h1] [b] NEW FEATURES[/b] [/h1]
[*][b] Creature attack changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Creature attack changed to click instead of hold when ability one is active.
[/list]
[*][b]Survivor annimation overhaul[/b]
[list]
[*] Survivor mobility animation overhaul
[*] Survivor fidget animations
[*] Survivor aim offsets
[/list]
[*][b]Survivor walk footstep sounds[/b]
[*][b]Character customization WIP[/b]
[list]
[*] Four male characters
[*] Four hair styles
[*] Five clothing tops
[*] Four clothing bottoms
[*] Three clothing shoes
[/list]
[*][b]Inventory WIP[/b]
[list]
[*] Invetory UI
[*] Selected Weapon UI
[*] Drop Item
[/list]
[list]
[*] Survivor UI change
[*] Name highlight
[/list]
[/list]
[h1] [b]BALANCING[/b] [/h1]
[list]
[*][b] Changed item pickup hitbox[/b]
[*][b] Creature ability charge time decreased[/b]
[*][b] Survivor stamina charges faster[/b]
[*][b] Map light spawn increased[/b]
[/list]
[h1] [b]PLANNED FEATURES[/b] [/h1]
We are planning on adding many new features to Paralysis in the next coming updates. These features will include new abilities for the creature. Such as traps and an EMP ability, which can shut off electronics in a small area. A sound overhaul will be implented. Which includes a new ambient sounds across the map. This will give a psychological horror element when wandering the corridors of the bunker. We have plans to add new maps to Paralysis. Finally there will be a new game mode coming very soon so stay tuned for future updates.
